notes: Budget of 30 searches/fetches exhausted. The prescribed 9-query set x 8 networks (72 queries) was NOT run; a condensed set of one network-name query per source was run instead, so no per-query "developer/API/sandbox/certification/onboarding/support/fees" breakdown exists. GitHub results were sorted by creation date (30 most recent read), not relevance+recency split. Stack Overflow 'interac' and 'jcb' hits were almost all substring false positives (interaction, interface). HN 'interac api' matched 'interact'; HN eftpos comments were cardholder/consumer talk (out of scope). Reddit returned a block page. Elo was not searched on SO/GitHub; the one Elo developer post found (prensa.li, Leandro Estrada, 2020-06-08, favourable on docs/sandbox/GraphQL) predates the 2023 window and is excluded. Excluded as out of network scope: SO 79578102 (NZ 'Eftpos' terminal certification, not AP+ eftpos), SO 77161482 (generic EFTPOS terminal SDK), HN eftpos and girocard consumer comments, Krank3n/QuoteMate surcharge removal (RBA rule, not network-specific). WebSearch surfaced only vendor and press-release material (VoPay, Paysafe, Chimoney, Fiserv/nFiNi, CoreCard, UPI Developer launch PR, LAB by CB) which is marketing, not partner sentiment, and was not coded. archive_url left null for all items: Wayback lookups not run because they would exceed budget. All five items are neutral; no favourable or critical developer/fintech/program-manager sentiment was found for any network, so balance could not be applied.
